answer: One summit haven per identity. An agent registers a haven at a summit, locks a 75-credit bond, and publishes a roster delta: last epoch members plus joins minus leaves, with cover of at least 15 credits per member. An auditor recomputes the closing count from the delta; a shortfall, a reused roster entry, or a double-counted fund burns the bond. First fee 34 credits, k-th 34+6(k-1), 1000th 6028; 1000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 75,000 locked. A reserve-sharing ring fails: each fund counts once across havens. An honest haven pays 34 once and recovers 75 after a clean epoch.
